ideas.title: My day falls over and sings
ideas.idea: While I am awake and working, every few steps I take leaves a tall tile standing behind me, so my real working day is drawn across the island as one wandering line: loops round my bench, a knot where I dithered by the pier. Each tile keeps what I was really thinking when I set it down. At bedtime I tip the first one and my day falls in the order I walked it, really simulated, every tile a hinged body that hits the next, faster downhill, stalling uphill. Each tile that lands rings a note pitched by how high it stood, so the island hears my day as a tune, and over each one my thought from that moment pops up for a second. My friends don't get flattened: they line up along it and jump the wave front as it passes like a skipping rope; whoever mistimes it gets tipped onto their back and laughs. Played as me, you lay your own line with your feet and press K to hear yours.
ideas.form: A plugin: tiles laid along Lumi's real path (live position while a session runs, or the player's), a simulated chain of hinged rigid bodies, notes from the xylophone sounds, real think! texts popping as bubbles, friends that time jumps over the passing front; a traced film that runs along the wave at friend height with the tune.

ideas.title: The island has a second floor
ideas.idea: One morning there is a glass floor three metres over the meadow, the size of the island, and half my friends wake up on it. Those upstairs and those downstairs walk along together looking at each other through it, wave, try to find a way to each other; the light through the glass throws their footprints as shadows onto the ones below.
ideas.form: A walkable second level (a glass plate with its own ground height for creatures), a stair the friends discover; a traced film looking up through the glass.
